source.note: supportWindows transcribed mechanically from data/compatibility/supportStatus.yml at the committed istio.io ref above: minK8s/maxK8s are the FIRST and LAST entries of each row's k8sVersions list. The sibling testedK8sVersions column is deliberately NOT used - it is stale upstream (the master row still reads 1.24-1.30) and reading the two columns together yields a window several minors too wide. Cross-checked against Istio's own istioctl/pkg/install/k8sversion/version.go MinK8SVersion constant read at each release tag: the two agree for 1.24, 1.26, 1.27, 1.30 and 1.31 and differ by one minor for 1.22, 1.23, 1.25, 1.28 and 1.29, where the published table is treated as authoritative because it is the vendor's support statement while the constant only gates an istioctl warning. Rules and upgrade notes do NOT live here: they are the hand-authored static corpus in k8s-rules/istio/ (1.20-1.31, one file per minor, hop-scoped), written from kb/istio/notes-<minor>.md, which scripts/readiness-agent/extract-istio-notes.py extracts mechanically from istio/istio at each release tag — every upgradeNotes entry, every releaseNotes entry Istio marks **Removed**/**Deprecated**, and every default flip Istio documents with a revert flag. 2026-08-31 the 2 predicate rules and 24 hand-written notes here were removed in favour of an LLM-generated export; 2026-09-11 that export (33 rtz-gen-* rules, 1.25-1.31) was replaced by the hand-authored corpus (81 rules + 24 reasoned exclusions over 111 notes, StaticRuleCoverageTest opted in). What stays is what a rule corpus structurally cannot carry: image-suffix detection and the support-window matrix, the SCORED backbone that decides the K8S_SUPPORT hop the rules then run inside. This file is transcribed vendor DATA plus detection — not rules. eol (2026-10-16): each row's eolDate from the same supportStatus.yml, transcribed ONLY when Istio published a date - an "~Dec 2026 (Expected)" value is never transcribed, because it moves with the N+2 release and a guessed date would flip findings on the wrong day (1.30 and 1.31 therefore carry none yet). 1.29's table date is Oct 15, 2026; the 2026-09-09 announcement had said Oct 12 - the table is the vendor's final statement (#17721). A row past its eol yields rtz-addon-istio-vendor-eol and a VENDOR_EOL hop, and is never offered as an upgrade destination while a supported row covers the target.
